clips.text: It is the people suffering this fear who start chanting, "the soul is immortal, the soul is immortal." The fearful and weak seek refuge in this way.
But both these concepts are born out of one and the same fallacy.
These are two forms of the same fallacy and are two different reactions of two types of people.
But, remember, the fallacy of both is the same, and in both ways it is the same fallacy that is strengthened.
I do not want to give any kind of support to this fallacy.
If I say the soul is not immortal, then that is an untruth.
If I say the soul is immortal, then that becomes an escape from your fear.
And those who are in fear are never able to know the truth.
Hence, I say death is unknown.
